note: Westfield (St. Dominic, [W]) has its Saturday 4:00 PM vigil every week, first Saturdays included. The 8 November 2026 bulletin, p. 2, lists "SATURDAY, NOVEMBER 7 – 32ND SUNDAY IN ORDINARY TIME" (a first Saturday) with "[W] 4:00PM" and an intention ("Busia, Aunt Irene & Auntie Barb"). The discontinued "Celebration of First Saturday Masses at St. Dominic's Parish" (25 Oct and 1 Nov issues, p. 4) was a separate devotion, so the seed answer that dropped first Saturdays (s19) was wrong. The 22 November issue, p. 2, lists "[W] 4:00PM" on 21 and 28 November.
